hero.titleSr: Kiɗan kewaye da hi-res, a kan Mac ɗinku.
hero.lede: Mai kunna kiɗa na Mac, kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe, don tarin kiɗan kewaye da hi-res. Kwafin faifan SACD da DVD-Video, DSD, DTS CD, fayilolin DTS-HD MA, TrueHD da Atmos suna zama a laburare ɗaya tare da kundayenku na stereo, tare da Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods. Gyaran sautin ɗaki yana auna ɗakinku da makirufo na USB kuma yana gyara kowace lasifika; a kashe yake har sai kun kunna shi. Hanyar sigina tana nuna kowane mataki daga fayil zuwa fitarwa. pillars.title: Kiɗan kewaye a laburare ɗaya
pillars.text: Kwafin SACD da waƙoƙin da aka ciro daga gare su, faifan DVD-Video, DTS CD, DTS-HD MA da TrueHD suna zama kusa da kundayenku na stereo kuma su kunna a matsayin Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods. Idan kundi yana da nau'ukan biyu, kowace waƙa tana bayyana sau ɗaya kuma nau'in da ya dace da fitarwarku ne yake kunnawa.

pillars.title: Hanyar sigina da za ku bincika
pillars.text: Ƙimar samfuri, tsawon kalmar bit, ƙari da sarrafa tashoshi, duk ana karanto su daga Core Audio. Sharuɗɗan bit-perfect suna cikin lambar tushe, tare da gwaje-gwaje na atomatik, gwajin loopback da jagorar tabbatarwa da na'urori.

pillars.title: Yana bincika fayilolin hi-res
pillars.text: Nazari yana nuna zurfin bit da aka cike da sifili da yiwuwar ƙara ƙimar samfuri ko asali mai asara. Hukunce-hukuncen bakan mita kimantawa ne, ana nuna su tare da hujjojinsu da iyakokinsu. Ana gudanar da nazarin iri ɗaya a sabar Linux kusa da fayilolinku.

pillars.title: Buɗaɗɗen tushe da za ku tantance
pillars.text: Kyauta a ƙarƙashin GPL. Karanta, gina kuma gyara mai kunnawar, har da sharuɗɗan fitarwarsa da gwaje-gwajensa. Babu asusu, biyan kuɗin shiga, talla ko aika bayanan amfani.

signal-path.title: Kowace waƙa a ƙimar samfurinta da zurfin bit nata na asali.
signal-path.lede: Hanyar Sigina tana jera kowane mataki daga fayil zuwa DAC ɗinku, bisa abin da aka karanto daga Core Audio, kuma tana faɗa idan wani abu ya canza samfuran.
body: Vespertine yana sauya na'urar zuwa ƙimar samfurin kowane fayil, kuma yana sake samfurawa da mai juyawar Apple mai ingancin mastering ne kawai idan DAC ba zai iya amfani da ƙimar ba. BIT-PERFECT yana bayyana ne kawai idan an cika sharuɗɗan da ke cikin lambar tushe: ƙimar samfuri ta asali, babu abin da yake canza samfuran, tsawon kalmar bit da ya dace, da na'urar da aka keɓe ko wadda babu wata manhaja da ke amfani da ita tare. An gwada kunna PCM har zuwa 768 kHz da DSD256 a Fosi Audio ZD3, da kuma har zuwa 384 kHz da DSD128 a FiiO K11.
list: Yanayin keɓe (hog) yana hana sauran manhajoji amfani da na'urar. A yanayin rabawa, maɓallan ƙarar sauti da Digital Crown suna daidaita DAC ɗinku; a yanayin keɓe ma za su iya, idan kun kunna hakan.
Yanayin integer yana aika PCM na bit 32 da ba a sarrafa ba kai tsaye zuwa DAC masu karɓar integers.
Daidaita da tushen bit 16 (a kashe tun farko) yana aika fayilolin bit 16 a matsayin bit 16 zuwa DAC masu yanayin bit 16 na gaske, ba tare da cika su da sifili ba.
Kunnawa ba tare da tazara ba, har da kundayen da takardar CUE ta raba waƙoƙinsu daga fayil ɗaya.
Yana tuna DAC ɗinku. Idan ba a haɗa shi ba, kiɗa yana kunnawa a Mafi kyawun na'urar da aka haɗa kuma ya koma idan DAC ya dawo.

Fitarwar da ba ta da na'urar sarrafa ƙarar sauti tata (HDMI, optical, line-out) za ta iya amfani da ta Vespertine, ana zaɓa ga kowace fitarwa. Idan ƙarar ta yi ƙasa da 100%, alamun suna faɗa cewa ba bit-perfect ba ne kuma.
Idan Vespertine ya rufe, yana mayar da DAC ɗinku zuwa ƙimar samfuri da zurfin bit da yake da su a da.

Gwajin loopback da aka gina a ciki yana kwatanta kowane samfuri da Vespertine yake aikawa zuwa na'ura ta kama-da-wane. Gwajin manhaja ne, an bayyana shi haka, kuma ba ya taɓa canza alamar BIT-PERFECT.

room-correction.title: Ku auna ɗakinku. Ku gyara kowace lasifika.
room-correction.lede: Ku auna ɗakinku da UMIK-1 ko wani makirufo na USB da aka tantance ma'auninsa, kuma Vespertine zai tsara matatu da suka dace da kowace lasifika daga abin da yake ji a kujerarku.
body: Sautuka masu hawa suna kunnawa ta lasifika ɗaya bayan ɗaya, a wurare ɗaya zuwa biyar kewaye da kujerar sauraronku. Kowace lasifika tana samun nata matatun, waɗanda aka tsara daga ma'aunin. Galibinsu ragewa ne: suna rage ƙololuwar ɗakin, kuma suna ɗaga faffadan ramukan sauti a hankali kawai. Ma'auni ɗaya ne ke saita jinkiri da matakin sautin kowace lasifika, don kowace lasifika ta isa kujerarku a lokaci ɗaya da ƙarar sauti iri ɗaya. Gyaran sautin ɗaki a kashe yake ta asali, kuma kunnawa na zama bit-perfect yayin da yake a kashe. Idan yana kunne, hanyar sigina tana nuna ROOM CORRECTION.
list: Manufofi uku: Warm (na asali), Gentle tilt da Flat. Ku gyara bass kaɗai ko cikakken fadi, kuma ku sake tsara matatun daga baya ba tare da sake aunawa ba.
Yana shigo da matatu daga REW ko Equalizer APO, tare da jinkiri da matakin sautin kowace lasifika, kuma yana fitar da rubutun Equalizer APO.
Yana shigo da fayilolin impulse response (WAV, AIFF, CAF ko FLAC) kuma yana kunna su ta convolution.
Stereo da 5.1.

Hoton Ɗaki yana nuna lasifikokin, kujerarku da kowane wurin makirufo yayin da ake auna shi. Sannan Bayyanar Lanƙwasa tana mayar da amsar da aka auna zuwa wadda ake hasashe, kuma maɓallin kafin/bayan yana kwatanta su.
room-correction.note: Lanƙwasar “bayan” hasashe ne daga ma'aunin da matatun, ba aunawa aka yi ba. Don ganin ainihin abin da ɗakin yake yi, ku sake aunawa yayin da gyaran yake kunne.
links: Yadda gyaran sautin ɗaki yake aiki
room-correction.alt: Hasashen gyaran sautin ɗaki na Vespertine ga lasifika biyu na stereo tare da manufar Warm: ga kowace lasifika, amsar sautin da aka auna, manufar da amsar da ake hasashe bayan gyara, tare da ƙololuwar ɗaki kusa da 120 Hz da aka rage da dB 14 da 18, da matatun kowace lasifika.
room-correction.floatAlt: Hoton Ɗaki a cikin jagoran aunawa: lasifikokin hagu da dama, kujera, da wuraren makirufo biyar kewaye da ita, na farkon yana da makirufo a kansa.

surround.title: Faifan 5.1 ɗinku, a laburare ɗaya.
surround.lede: Kiɗa mai tashoshi da yawa yana kunnawa a matsayin Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods, ko a haɗe tashoshinsa zuwa stereo bisa tsarin tashoshin a DAC na stereo.
body: Ana warware DTS CD zuwa 5.1. Kwafin SACD, waƙoƙin da aka ciro daga SACD, FLAC mai tashoshi da yawa, TrueHD da DTS-HD MA suna kunnawa a matsayin Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods ko a haɗe tashoshinsu zuwa stereo a DAC na stereo. Dolby Digital Plus mai Atmos yana amfani da mai sarrafa abubuwan sauti na macOS; TrueHD Atmos da DTS:X suna kunna tushen tashoshinsu. Fitar da kowace tasha zuwa tashar da ta dace na gwaji ne, ba a gwada shi a kan risivoci na gaske da USB DAC masu tashoshi da yawa ba (an gwada talabijin ɗaya na Sony ta HDMI: duba docs/DEVICES.md); ana neman rahotanni.
list: Nau'ukan stereo da na kewaye na kundi suna bayyana sau ɗaya; Vespertine yana kunna wanda ya dace da fitarwar, ko wanda kuka kafe.

Aika bitstream na Dolby Digital, DD+ da DTS-CD zuwa risiva na gwaji ne, ba a gwada shi a kan risivoci na gaske da USB DAC masu tashoshi da yawa ba (an gwada talabijin ɗaya na Sony ta HDMI: duba docs/DEVICES.md); ana neman rahotanni. Gwaje-gwajen siginar ɗauka suna amfani da mai karanta S/PDIF na FFmpeg. Ba a tallafa wa wucewar TrueHD da DTS-HD MA kai tsaye zuwa risiva a macOS ba.
Fitarwa don Spatial Audio a matsayin stereo na binaural don belun kunne ko ALAC mai tashoshi da yawa don na'urorin Apple, tare da alamomi da hotunan bangon kundi.

discs.title: Kunna kwafin faifan da kansa.
discs.lede: Nuna wa Vespertine kwafin SACD ko DVD-Video, sai ya kunna kiɗa kai tsaye daga cikinsa, ba tare da ɗora, ciro ko rubuta komai ba.
body: Kwafin SACD .iso yana kunna sassan stereo da 5.1 nasa, ko an matse su da DST ko ba a matse su ba, tare da sunaye daga rubutun da ke cikin faifan kansa. Ana warware DST zuwa ainihin DSD ɗin, don haka stereo yana zuwa DAC ɗinku a matsayin DSD na asali ta DoP idan DAC yana tallafa masa, kuma 5.1 yana kunnawa a matsayin Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods. Kiɗan LPCM a faifan DVD-Video (.iso ko foldar VIDEO_TS) yana kunnawa daidai bit da bit, kundi ɗaya ga kowane take da waƙa ɗaya ga kowane babi.
list: Ya yi daidai bit da bit da sacd_extract a faifai biyu na gaske. Faifai masu sashen 5.0, masu sashen tashoshi da yawa kawai, ko na DSD128 da sama, an gwada su da kwafin faifan gwaji na ƙirƙira kawai ya zuwa yanzu.

DSF da DSDIFF daga DSD64 zuwa DSD512, har da DSDIFF da aka matse da DST, suna fita a matsayin DoP zuwa DAC masu karɓar ƙimar samfurin siginar ɗauka, ko su koma PCM mai ƙimar samfuri mai yawa. An tabbatar da DoP har zuwa DSD256 a Fosi Audio ZD3 da kuma har zuwa DSD128 a FiiO K11; ba a gwada DSD512 ta DoP a kan na'urori ba.
DVD-Video LPCM na bit 16, 20 da 24, a 48 da 96 kHz, har zuwa tashoshi 8. Ba a tallafa wa DVD-Audio ba, kuma faifai masu ɓoyayyen bayani (CSS) suna buƙatar kwafin da aka warware ɓoyayyen bayaninsa.

analysis.kicker: Gano hi-res na bogi da bakan mita
analysis.title: Gano fayilolin “hi-res” da ba haka suke ba.
analysis.lede: Za a iya nazarin kowane fayil don gano ainihin zurfin bit ɗinsa, ainihin faɗin zangon mitocinsa da alamomin da masu sa lambar sauti mai asara da masu sake samfurawa suka bari.
body: Hukunce-hukunce suna zuwa da hujjojinsu kuma suna bayyana wasu dalilan da za su iya haddasa abin da aka gani, sannan jerin waƙoƙin Hi-Res da Ake Shakku yana tara su. Cikawa da sifili ne kawai ake tabbatarwa da cikakken daidaito: ana nuna hukunce-hukuncen bakan mita a matsayin tambayoyi, domin wasu fayiloli masu asara amma masu babban bitrate suna wucewa a matsayin na gaske, kuma matatun mastering masu yanke mitoci da kaifi, tushen FM da sautin da aka kwaso daga tef ko vinyl na iya zama abin shakku. Yayin da kiɗa ke kunnawa, ma'aunai da bakan mita na kai tsaye suna nuna abin da yake fita, har da DoP.
list: Sauti na bit 16 da aka cike da sifili a cikin kwantena na bit 24
Mai yiwuwa an ƙara ƙimar samfurin masters masu ingancin CD, aka sayar da su a matsayin 96 ko 192 kHz
Mai yiwuwa asalinsa mai asara ne: MP3 ko AAC da aka juya zuwa FLAC
Mai yiwuwa mitocin sama na ƙirƙira ne daga SBR ko “ingantawa da AI”
vespertine-analyze yana gudanar da nazarin iri ɗaya a sabar Linux kusa da fayilolinku; manhajar tana shigo da sakamakon.
analysis.note: Fayil ɗin da ke wannan hoton allo na bogi ne da aka yi da gangan: kiɗan bidiyon gabatarwar kansa, an sa masa lambar MP3 kuma an ƙara ƙimar samfurinsa zuwa 24/192 a ƙarƙashin sunan ƙungiyar kiɗa na ƙirƙira.
links: Yadda nazarin yake aiki, da inda yake kasa ganewa
analysis.alt: Shafin Nazari yana nuna “remaster” na 24/192 a matsayin mai yiwuwar asali mai asara: Bakan mita na dogon lokaci nasa yana tsayawa a 16 kHz.

airpods.title: Sauti marar asara a AirPods Max, kuma yana faɗa.
airpods.lede: Idan an haɗa su da kebul na USB-C, ana gane AirPods Max a matsayin na'urar sauti marar asara ta bit 24 / 48 kHz.
body: Kiɗan 48 kHz yana kunnawa bit-perfect, kuma ana juya duk sauran da mai sake samfurawa na Apple mai ingancin mastering, duk a bayyane. Ta Bluetooth, Vespertine yana faɗa muku cewa haɗin AAC ne. Wannan ya dogara ne da bayanin Apple na hanyar kebul da abin da aka karanto daga Core Audio, domin AirPods ba su da fitarwar dijital da za a yi loopback da ita.
airpods.alt: Jerin Waƙoƙi Mai Wayo na waƙoƙin bit 24 / 48 kHz, an tace zuwa Oasis, yana kunnawa bit-perfect a AirPods Max ta USB-C.

library.title: Lilo kamar a Apple Music. Tsara kamar ma'aikacin laburare.
library.lede: Kundaye, mawaƙa, waƙoƙi da salo-salo, kowanne da matatun da za ku iya haɗawa, da Gauraya ga kowannensu.
list: Matatu don tsarin fayil, bit 24, 88.2 kHz da sama, tashoshi da yawa, salo, shekara, ƙimar samfuri, tashoshi da Hukuncin Nazari. Nema ba ya bambanta manyan baƙaƙe da ƙanana ko alamomin lafazi.
Jerin Waƙoƙi Mai Wayo a ma'aunan da kuka saba da su: bit 24, 88.2 kHz.
Remasters, sigogin mono da stereo da SACD na kundi ɗaya suna zama a kati ɗaya; ku zaɓi sigar idan kun buɗe shi.

Waɗanda Aka Fi So da adadin lokutan kunnawa, ana ajiye su a laburare kuma ba a taɓa rubuta su a fayilolinku ba. Yana shigo da jerin waƙoƙin M3U da Apple Music, adadin lokutan kunnawa da waɗanda aka fi so.
Mai gyara alamomi tare da kwafin ajiya da mayarwa da mataki ɗaya, da ƙarin bayanai daga MusicBrainz wanda yake nuna gwargwadon tabbacinsa kafin ya rubuta komai.

Foldojin cibiyar sadarwa ta SMB, NFS ko WebDAV, tare da ajiyar wucin gadi, Riƙe don Wajen Layi da kunnawa da aka gina don sabobin da ba su da sauri: ana fara loda waƙoƙi a Mac ɗinku kafin su fara kunnawa, tare da zoben lodi a maɓallin kunnawa yayin da hakan ke gudana.

Nemo Waƙoƙi yana bincika kowane faifan ajiya don gano ainihin kiɗanku kuma ya bar tarkace. Ɗan gajeren saiti a buɗewar farko yana zaɓar fitarwarku kuma yana bayyana abin da Amfani na keɓe da ReplayGain suke yi.
EQ na parametric ga kowace fitarwa wanda yake shigo da saitattun AutoEQ da Equalizer APO. A kashe tun farko; idan yana kunne, Hanyar Sigina tana cewa EQ maimakon BIT-PERFECT.
Ƙaramin Mai Kunnawa, ƙarin sarrafawa a sandar menu, maɓallan kafofin watsa labarai, ReplayGain da sabuntawa na atomatik masu sa hannu.

languages.title: Yana magana da harshenku.
languages.lede: An fassara kowane menu, saiti da saƙon Hanyar Sigina zuwa harsuna {languages} ban da Turanci.
body: Daga Yukiraniyanci, Jamusanci da Jafananci zuwa Swahili, Tamil da Hausa, tare da tsarin jam'i da rubuta lambobi na kowane harshe, da Sinanci Sauƙaƙaƙƙe, na Gargajiya da na Hong Kong, kowanne da nasa ƙamus. Larabci, Ibrananci, Farisanci da Urdu suna da tsarin shafi daga dama zuwa hagu.

Yadda ake bincika fassarorin: binciken atomatik a kowane sauyi yana tabbatar da cewa kowane rubutu a manhajar yana cikin duk harsuna 44 tare da guraben cike iri ɗaya da nau'ukan jam'in da kowane harshe yake buƙata, kuma an duba manyan allunan a harsuna da dama don rubutun da ya yanke ko ya hau kan wani da juyawar tsarin dama zuwa hagu. An fara su a matsayin fassarar na'ura da aka yi da kulawa, don haka ana matuƙar maraba da gyaran masu harshen a GitHub.

whatsNew.title: Sabbin abubuwa a {version}.
whatsNew.meta: kun riga kun girka? Yana sabunta kansa, ko kuma {brewUpgrade}
whatsNew.inEnglish: Ba a fassara waɗannan bayanan siga ba tukuna, don haka ana nuna su da Turanci.

items.a: I. Vespertine kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne ƙarƙashin GPL-3.0. Babu asusu, babu biyan kuɗin rajista, babu talla kuma babu tattara bayanan amfani ta atomatik (sirri). Yana shiga intanet ne kawai don duba sabuntawa, da kuma tuntuɓar MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive ko ListenBrainz, ko nemo hotunan bangon kundi don halinku na Discord, idan kun nemi hakan.

macOS {minMacOS} ({minMacOSName}) ko na gaba, a Apple silicon ko Intel. Ba a gwada a kan na'urorin Intel ba; sigar Intel ta yi aiki ƙarƙashin Rosetta, kuma ana maraba da rahotanni daga Mac na Intel na gaske.

items.q: Yaya zan girka shi kuma in sabunta shi?
items.a: Sauke DMG, buɗe shi sannan ku matsar da Vespertine zuwa Applications. An sa masa sa hannun Developer ID kuma Apple ya tantance shi, kuma yana sabunta kansa; kowane sabuntawa yana da sa hannu. Da Homebrew: {brew}, sannan {brewUpgrade} ko sabuntawar da ke cikin manhajar.

items.q: Yana yaɗa kiɗa daga Qobuz, TIDAL ko Apple Music?
items.a: A'a. Vespertine yana kunna kiɗan da kuka mallaka, a Mac ɗinku, a ma'ajiyoyin waje ko a Folda ta cibiyar sadarwa. Ba zai iya kunna abubuwan da aka sauke ta rajistar Apple Music masu kariyar DRM ba.

items.q: Ta yaya zan san cewa da gaske bit-perfect ne?
items.a: Hanyar Sigina tana karanta ainihin abin da Core Audio ya yi: ƙimar samfuri da aka saita wa na'urar, tsarin bayanan sauti da take amfani da shi a zahiri da kuma wanda yake riƙe da ikon ta. Masu warware sauti suna da gwaje-gwaje na atomatik (an kwatanta TrueHD da tushensa, DTS kuma da mai warware sauti na FFmpeg kansa), Gwajin Loopback da ke ciki yana duba Hanyar manhaja samfuri bayan samfuri, kuma vespertine-probe yana ba ku damar duba na'urorinku. Yadda za ku tabbatar da kanku.

items.q: Shin yana yin gyaran sautin ɗaki?
items.a: Ee. Ku auna ɗakinku da UMIK-1 ko wani makirufo na USB da aka tantance ma'auninsa a wurare ɗaya zuwa biyar kewaye da kujerarku, kuma Vespertine zai tsara matatu da suka dace da kowace lasifika, ya kuma daidaita jinkiri da matakin sautinsu, a stereo ko 5.1. Yana kuma shigo da matatun REW da Equalizer APO da fayilolin impulse response. A kashe yake ta asali, kunnawa na zama bit-perfect yayin da yake a kashe, kuma hanyar sigina tana nuna ROOM CORRECTION yayin da yake kunne. Yadda gyaran sautin ɗaki yake aiki.

items.q: Zai iya kunna faifan SACD da DVD?
items.a: Yana kunna kwafinsu. Kwafin SACD .iso, na stereo da tashoshi da yawa, masu matsawar DST ko marasa matsawa, da kiɗan LPCM a kwafin DVD-Video ko foldojin VIDEO_TS suna kunnawa kai tsaye daga kwafin, ba tare da cire komai ba. Ba a tallafa wa DVD-Audio ba, kuma DVD masu ɓoyewa ta CSS suna buƙatar kwafin da aka cire wa ɓoyewar.

Dolby Digital Plus mai Atmos yana kunnawa ta na'urar sarrafa abubuwan sauti ta macOS, a matsayin Spatial Audio mai bin motsin kai a AirPods. TrueHD Atmos da DTS:X suna kunna tushen tashoshinsu marar asara; ba a sarrafa abubuwan sautinsu. Bitstream zuwa risivar AV na gwaji ne, ba a gwada shi a kan risivoci na gaske ba; ana neman rahotanni.

Sai idan kun gyara alamomi kawai, kuma a lokacin ana fara yin kwafin ajiyar kowane fayil kuma za a iya mayar da shi yadda yake a mataki ɗaya. Ana nuni ga foldoji a inda suke; shigo da su yana ƙirƙirar kwafin APFS waɗanda ba sa cin ƙarin sarari.

items.q: A kan waɗanne na'urori aka gwada shi?
items.a: An gwada kunna PCM har zuwa 768 kHz da DSD256 a Fosi Audio ZD3, da kuma har zuwa 384 kHz da DSD128 a FiiO K11, inda aka gwada Yanayin integer ma. An kuma gwada shi a AirPods Max ta USB-C da Bluetooth, lasifikokin MacBook Pro, da TV na Sony ta HDMI a 5.1. Ba a gwada a kan na'urorin Intel ba. Bitstream zuwa risiva da fitarwar DAC mai tashoshi da yawa na gwaji ne, ba a gwada su a kan risivoci na gaske da USB DAC masu tashoshi da yawa ba (an gwada TV ɗaya na Sony ta HDMI: duba docs/DEVICES.md); ana neman rahotanni.

Mai yiwuwa: manhajar tana da Turanci da wasu harsuna {languages}, har da Larabci, Ibrananci, Farisanci da Urdu masu tafiya daga dama zuwa hagu. Vespertine yana bin yaren da aka saita masa a Saitunan Tsarin Aiki. Ana maraba da gyara daga masu jin harsunan a matsayin harshen uwa a GitHub.

privacy.staysTitle: Abin da ke zama a kan Mac ɗinku
privacy.stays: Rumbun bayanan laburarenku, jerin waƙoƙi, ƙididdigar kunnawa, sakamakon nazarin fayiloli, ma'ajiyar hotunan kundi da saituna ana adana su a cikin Library na mai amfani a kan Mac ɗinku. Kalmomin sirri na foldojin cibiyar sadarwa da token ɗinku na ListenBrainz, idan kun ƙara ɗaya, ana adana su a cikin Keychain na macOS. Gyaran sautin ɗaki yana amfani da makirufon aunawarku ne kawai yayin da kuke gudanar da aunawa, kuma yana ajiye rikodin a cikin foldar Documents ɗinku. Babu ɗayansu da ake lodawa zuwa ko'ina.
privacy.onlineTitle: Lokacin da manhajar ke shiga intanet
online: Binciken sabuntawa. Vespertine tana tambayar GitHub jerin sabuntawarta kusan sau ɗaya a rana, da kuma lokacin da kuka zaɓi Bincika Sabuntawa. GitHub na ganin adireshin IP ɗinku, kamar yadda yake a kowane saukewa. Kuna iya kashe bincike ta atomatik a cikin Saituna.

MusicBrainz da Cover Art Archive. Kawai lokacin da kuka yi amfani da Nema a MusicBrainz ko Inganta Bayanan Waƙa (Nemo Waƙoƙi a Wannan Mac yana ba da Inganta don waƙoƙin da yake ƙarawa, a matsayin akwatin zaɓi da za ku iya cirewa), Vespertine tana aika sunayen kundi, mawaƙi da waƙar da take nema zuwa musicbrainz.org. Idan “Ɗauko hotunan bangon kundi” a kunne yake a cikin Saituna, tana sauke hotunan bango daga coverartarchive.org, wanda ke samar da su daga Internet Archive (archive.org). MetaBrainz Foundation ce ke gudanar da MusicBrainz da Cover Art Archive.

ListenBrainz. Kawai idan kun kunna scrobbling kuma kun shigar da token ɗinku, Vespertine tana aika wa listenbrainz.org waƙoƙin da kuke kunnawa: take, mawaƙi, kundi, tsawon lokaci da lambobin ID na MusicBrainz ɗinsu idan fayilolinku na ɗauke da su. Tana aika “ana kunnawa yanzu” lokacin da waƙa ta fara, da kuma sauraro tare da lokacinsa da zarar kun ji rabin waƙar ko minti huɗu.

Discord. Kawai idan kun kunna matsayin Discord a cikin Saituna, Vespertine tana gaya wa manhajar Discord da ke kan Mac ɗinku, ta hanyar haɗin da ke zama a kan Mac ɗinku, abin da ake kunnawa: take, mawaƙi, kundi, tsari da ci gaba. Discord tana nuna shi a matsayin matsayinku ga mutanen da za su iya ganin ayyukanku. Don nuna hoton bangon kundin, Vespertine tana nemansa ta suna, saboda Discord tana iya nuna hotuna daga yanar gizo kawai: a coverartarchive.org idan fayilolinku na ɗauke da ID na fitowar MusicBrainz, in ba haka ba a iTunes Search na Apple (itunes.apple.com), wanda ke karɓar sunayen mawaƙi da kundi. Sai Discord ta sauke hoton daga can. Kuna iya kashe hotunan bango, kuma ba a taɓa loda fayilolinku da hotunansu ba.

Foldojin cibiyar sadarwa. Vespertine tana haɗawa da sabobin da kuka ƙara, ba wani wuri ba, don karanta waƙoƙinku. Yayin da folda ke haɗe, tana duba kusan kowane minti ɗaya cewa sabar har yanzu tana amsawa, kuma tana neman sababbin waƙoƙi kowane rabin awa (amma ba ta yin hakan yayin da kuke kunnawa daga gare ta).
website: Ana ajiye wannan shafin a GitHub Pages, wanda zai iya rubuta adireshin IP na maziyarta; duba sanarwar sirri ta GitHub. Maɓallan saukewa suna kai ga fitowar manhajar a GitHub. Shafin ba ya saka kukis kuma yana loda nau'ikan rubutunsa, hotunansa da bidiyonsa daga wannan shafin.

Don sanin waɗanne shafuka da maɓallai mutane ke amfani da su, shafin yana ƙirga ziyara da Umami, manhaja mai mutunta sirri da muke gudanarwa da kanmu a stats.szeremeta.org. Ba ta saka kukis, ba ta adana komai a na'urarku, ba ta riƙe adireshin IP ɗinku, kuma ba ta raba komai da masu talla ko wani kamfani. Tana rubuta shafin, shafin da kuka fito daga gare shi, ƙasarku a ƙiyasce, burauzarku, tsarin aiki, girman allo da harshe, da dannawa a kan maɓallan saukewa, GitHub da Homebrew. Ba za ta iya bin ku a shafukan yanar gizo daban-daban ko gane ku ba, kuma tana tsallake maziyartan da burauzarsu ke aika Do Not Track. Manhajar ba ta taɓa tuntuɓarta ba.

Idan kun zaɓi harshe da menu na harshe na shafin, burauzarku tana tuna zaɓin a na'urarku (a cikin ma'ajiyarta ta gida), don kada shafin ya mayar da ku. Ba a taɓa aika shi ko'ina ba, kuma shafin yana aiki iri ɗaya ba tare da shi ba.

0.14.0.summary: Vespertine 0.14.0 ya ƙara gyaran sautin ɗaki: ku auna lasifikokinku da makirufon UMIK-1 sannan ku kunna kiɗa ta matatun da aka yi don ɗakinku. Haka kuma yana hana bayanan kunnawa daga cibiyar sadarwa ƙarewa.
0.14.0.notes:
### Gyaran sautin ɗaki
- **Auna ɗakinku.** Sanya makirufon UMIK-1 da aka daidaita a kujerar sauraro, sai Vespertine ya kunna sautukan gwaji masu hawa ta kowace lasifika bi da bi, a wurare 1 zuwa 5 (5 tun farko: kujerar, sannan hagu, dama, gaba da baya). Yana fara duba Matakin sauti da hanyar zuwa kowace lasifika, yana ƙin karɓar gwajin da bai yi kyau ba kuma yana ba ku damar sake gwadawa ko ci gaba daga inda kuka tsaya. Ana tallafa wa stereo da 5.1 duka biyu.
- **Matatu ga kowace lasifika.** Daga ma'aunin, Vespertine yana gina ƙaramin rukunin matatu ga kowace lasifika, yawanci don rage kololuwar bass da ɗaki ke ƙarawa. Zaɓi manufa (Mai ɗumi ne tun farko, ko Ɗan karkata ko Lebur) da fadi (bass kaɗai, ko Cikakken fadi) sannan a sake daidaita matatun daga ma'aunin da aka adana ba tare da sake aunawa ba. Jadawalin yana nuna abin da aka auna, abin da aka yi hasashen zai kasance bayan gyara da Manufa, kuma ana yi wa hasashen alamar cewa hasashe ne.
- **Daidaita jinkiri da matakin sauti.** Ana kuma auna jinkiri da matakin sautin kowace lasifika, don haka ana jinkirta lasifikokin da suka fi kusa har sai sautin wadda ta fi nisa ya iso, kuma ana rage ƙarar waɗanda suka fi ƙara zuwa matakin wadda ta fi shiru.
- **Kawo matatunku.** Shigo da fayil ɗin matatu na Equalizer APO ko REW (jinkiri, matakin sauti da matatu ga kowace lasifika), ko shigo da impulse response (WAV, AIFF, CAF ko FLAC) don a kunna su a matsayin matatun convolution. Fitar da bayani a matsayin rubutun Equalizer APO ko a matsayin bayanin Vespertine. Layukan da Vespertine ba zai iya kunnawa ba ana ƙin su tare da lambar layin, maimakon a kunna su a matsayin wani abu dabam.
- **A kashe yake tun farko, don haka bit-perfect yana nan bit-perfect.** Ana kunna gyaran sautin ɗaki ga kowace fitarwa dabam, kuma yana ɗaure da fitarwar da aka yi ma'aunin a kanta. Yayin da yake sauya samfuran sauti, Hanyar Sigina tana nuna ROOM CORRECTION kuma ba a ƙara yi wa rafin sautin alamar bit-perfect ba. Idan yana a kashe, ba a taɓa sautin da ake kunnawa ko kaɗan. Yanayin integer da Daidaita da bit 16 suna kasancewa a kashe yayin da yake kunne.
- **Abin da yake shafa.** PCM na stereo da 5.1 da Vespertine ke sarrafawa. Ga bitstream na Dolby da DTS, Atmos da sauran adadin tashoshi, yana janye kansa, kuma Hanyar Sigina tana faɗin dalili. Ana mayar da DSD a kan DAC mai DoP zuwa PCM yayin da gyaran ke kunne domin a gyara shi shi ma; yi alama a kan Riƙe DSD na asali a waccan fitarwar don a aika shi a matsayin DSD na asali ba tare da gyara ba.
- **Taga ɗaya.** Duba → Gyaran Sautin Ɗaki, haka kuma daga tagar Mai Daidaita Sauti da saitunan kowace fitarwa, tana ɗauke da maɓallin kunnawa da kashewa, Auna, Shigo da, Fitar da, bayanan, jadawalin kafin da bayan, manufa da fadi, da jinkiri, matakin sauti da matatun kowace lasifika. Wannan ya maye gurbin tagar beta ta Auna Ɗaki ta baya. An bayyana hanyar a `docs/ROOM-CORRECTION.md`.

### Kunnawa daga cibiyar sadarwa
- **Ƙarancin katsewa daga NAS.** Yanzu ana kwafar waƙoƙin da ke Folda ta cibiyar sadarwa zuwa Mac ɗinku kafin su kunna, kuma ana kwafar waƙa ta gaba tun da wuri, don haka ɗan tangarɗar cibiyar sadarwa ba ya ƙara tsayar da kiɗa. Ana karanta manyan fayilolin DSD ta hanyar da ke shirya bayanai masu nisa gaba.
- **Zoben lodawa a maɓallin kunnawa.** Yayin da Vespertine yake jiran bayanai daga cibiyar sadarwa, maɓallin kunnawa/dakata yana nuna ƙaramin zobe mai juyawa (yana tsaye idan Rage Motsi yana kunne). Ana sake gwada karatun da ya gaza na ɗan lokaci.
- **Iyakoki.** Katsewa mai tsawo sosai, ko hanyar sadarwar da ta fi kiɗan jinkiri, har yanzu na iya sa kunnawa ya dakata don sake cika bayanai. Kwafin ma'ajiya suna amfani da 8 GB a iyakar su, kuma tushen da ya fi haka girma yana kasa tare da saƙo bayyananne. Duba `docs/NETWORK-PLAYBACK.md`.

### Sauran sabbin abubuwa
- **DoP yana kunne tun farko ga DAC da aka sani.** FiiO K11 da Fosi Audio ZD3 suna farawa da DoP a kunne. Idan kun kashe shi, Vespertine yana tunawa.
- **Waɗanda Aka Ƙara Kwanan Nan yana nuna kundaye 150**, maimakon 60, don haka shigo da kundaye da yawa ba ya ture waɗanda aka ƙara gabansa daga jerin.
- **Fosi Audio ZD3.** Yanzu ZD3 yana cikin jerin na'urorin da ake tallafa wa kuma an sake ɗaukar hotunan gidan yanar gizon da shi.
- **Gidan yanar gizo.** Akwai layin "Ba shi tauraro a GitHub" da "Shiga tattaunawar" a ƙarƙashin maɓallan saukewa.

### Tabbatarwa
- Rukunin gwaje-gwajen injin sauti, laburare da manhaja sun ci, har da sabbin gwaje-gwajen ƙirar matatun ɗaki, kunnawa ta matakin gyara da matatar convolution, matakan aunawa a kan ɗakin kwaikwayo, tsare-tsaren fayilolin shigo da su da ma'ajiyar cibiyar sadarwa. Ana kuma duba lambar sautin da ke aiki kai tsaye da kayan gano kurakuran adireshin ƙwaƙwalwa, na zarurrukan aiki masu gudana tare da na halayen da ba a ayyana ba.
- An duba a kan na'urori na gaske: cikakken aunawa da UMIK-1 a kujerar sauraro, matatun da aka gina daga gare shi, da kunnawa ta gyaran sautin ɗaki a kan Fosi Audio ZD3 tare da lasifikokin stereo.

0.13.2.summary: Vespertine 0.13.2 yana kunna DSD na 5.1 a Spatial Audio a AirPods, yana sanar da ku idan an canza sauti ko an rage tashoshinsa, kuma ba ya ƙara makalewa yayin fita.
0.13.2.notes:
### Spatial Audio
- **Yanzu DSD na 5.1 yana kunnawa a Spatial Audio.** Ana canza fayil ɗin DSD na 5.1 (DSF, DSDIFF, DSDIFF mai matsawar DST ko Kwafin SACD) zuwa PCM kuma ana sanya kowace tasha a inda ta dace, don haka LFE da tashoshin kewaye ba sa ƙara ɓacewa. A baya, tashoshin DSDIFF masu zaman kansu kan faɗa kan tushen lasifikoki uku kuma tashoshin baya su ɓace.
- **Yana faɗin abin da ya faru da sautin.** Hanyar Sigina tana nuna **DSD → PCM** kusa da SPATIAL ko Downmix, kuma sabbin sanarwa biyu, "An canza daga DSD" da "An rage zuwa stereo", suna bayyana idan sun dace. An fassara dukkansu zuwa harsuna 44 duka.
- Mai haɓaka manhajar ya duba a AirPods Max.

### Abubuwan da aka gyara
- **Fita ba ta ƙara makalewa.** Cmd-Q kan bar alamar linzamin kwamfuta tana juyawa yayin da Vespertine yake jiran na'urar sauti. Yanzu yana fita nan take.
- **Ana karanta fayilolin tashoshi da yawa daidai.** Fayilolin RF64 da Wave64 suna buɗewa yadda ya kamata, ana karanta sunayen tashoshin DSD daga fayil ɗin, kuma rarraba tashoshi masu zaman kansu da yawa yana bin tsarin tashoshin fayil ɗin kansa.

### Tabbatarwa
- Rukunin gwaje-gwajen injin sauti, laburare da manhaja sun ci, har da sabbin gwaje-gwajen da ke kunna kowane tsarin DSD na 5.1 ta Spatial Audio kuma su duba cewa kowace tasha ta isa inda ta dace. Gwajin matsayin hagu/dama yana gudana a Mac na gaske kaɗai; na'urorin gwajin GitHub suna tsallake wannan gwaji guda.
